notes: Seed engine: flat-shaded boxes and cones painted on a 2D canvas.

narration: You wake standing on something cool and faintly gritty, a disc of pale grey stone dust that glows softly under your feet. Beyond it, only dark, soft and unmoving. Far to the north, a single small light flickers, amber and patient, like a lantern held by someone who is waiting.

facts.description: A wide, flat circle of pale grey stone dust about 10 m across, faintly luminous, fading to darkness at its edges.
facts.placement: centered under the wanderer at the origin

facts.description: A tiny warm amber light, the size of a lantern flame, flickering gently and hanging about 1.5 m above the ground.
facts.placement: about 40 m north of the wanderer

notes: I laid a pale grey dust disc (a square slab, since I only have boxes) under the Wanderer on a near-black ground, and placed a small amber lantern 40 m north at about 1.5 m high.
